description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs during WildChat conversations, matched to online articles from two identified news agencies. The largest category is 'Draft/Other,' accounting for approximately 26.4% of the total, followed by 'Press Release' at 18.7%. 'External News Article' and 'Interview' are the next largest categories, representing 18.1% and 8.8%, respectively. Notably, 'Organizational Report' consistently exceeds 'Event Posting,' with 9.7% compared to 6.6%. Additionally, 'Social Media Post' shows a slight increase over 'Email,' with 1.5% versus 2.7%. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each stimulus type, with all categories labeled and color-coded for clarity.
